records.title: Cardioprotective effect of methanolic extract of  Ixora coccinea  Linn. leaves on doxorubicin-induced cardiac toxicity in rats
records.method: Dried powdered leaves underwent methanol Soxhlet extraction, solvent removal and drying before rat experiments.
records.limitation: Laboratory extract only, not leaf tea, a heart-protection treatment or human dose.

records.title: Evaluation of pharmacological activity of  Hibiscus tiliaceus
records.method: Experimental preparations used ethanol-containing extraction and solvent concentration.
records.limitation: The aqueous ethanol extraction is not a water-only home decoction. It does not establish human wound-treatment or pregnancy safety.

records.title: Gastroprotective Effect of  Oxalis corniculata  (Whole Plant) on Experimentally Induced Gastric Ulceration in Wistar Rats
records.method: Dried whole-plant powder was defatted and extracted using laboratory solvents before rat-ulcer experiments.
records.limitation: This does not supply edible-leaf processing, a safe serving or a human ulcer-treatment method.

records.title: Acute and 28-Day Repeated-Dose Oral Toxicity Assessment of  Abelmoschus moschatus  Medik. in Healthy Wistar Rats
records.method: Leaves underwent sequential solvent/water extraction and drying for rat toxicity experiments.
records.limitation: The method does not validate seed-flavoured coffee, food-grade quantities or general human safety.

records.title: Antidiabetic activity of flower buds of  Michelia champaca  Linn
records.method: Dried powdered flower buds were used for comparative laboratory extracts, including a separate boiled-water extract, then concentrated for rat experiments.
records.limitation: No human diabetes dose, beginner recipe or resolution of the separate quarantined stem-bark metadata.
